model_description: FUnIE-GAN with frozen BatchNorm running statistics (epoch-1 running means, variances, and counters frozen; affine weight/bias parameters remained trainable).

loss_recipe.generator: MSE(D(G(raw), raw), 1) + 7 * L1(G(raw), reference) + 3 * VGG19_conv5_2_MSE(G(raw), reference)
loss_recipe.note: The discriminator fake image is generated under no_grad during the D update; this preserves the objective while avoiding an unused generator gradient.

configuration.preprocessing: paired RGB resize 256x256 bicubic; tensors normalized to [-1,1]; deterministic aligned p=0.5 horizontal flip only for train
configuration.only_experimental_change: After every generator.train()/discriminator.train(), all BatchNorm2d modules are reset to eval mode; affine weight/bias remain requires_grad=True and are optimized.

vgg19.input_semantics: [-1,1] paired tensors passed directly, matching the pinned official implementation

raw_baseline.metric_preprocessing: same 256x256 bicubic RGB resize and [-1,1] to [0,1] conversion as enhanced validation metrics

scope_guard: UIEB test pairs and challenging images were not used for training or candidate selection. This record does not replace detector inputs with enhanced images.
